text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган overtakes her
opponents at full
speed and leaves her
mark on the Takarazuka
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her next target is the autumn Tenno
Sho! Her
desire to blow past the
competition with all her
might is
renewed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At the same time, having witnessed
Mayano Top
Gun racing at full speed
with her own eyes...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан leaves the racecourse with a
fire lit in
her heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
